name: STRATA community labs
description: Extra labs in the STRATA format — hash-verified, loaded through the in-app shelf into a sandboxed worker.

labs.title: Unvalidated redirect after login
labs.blurb: The login page sends users wherever returnTo says. //host is protocol-relative; javascript: is worse.

labs.title: Reflected XSS when every obvious tag is blocked
labs.blurb: script, img, svg and iframe are all banned. The HTML grammar has 110+ elements — details open ontoggle never read the list. Ships with a defender edition.

labs.title: A display name rendered as a template — {{7*7}} becomes 49
labs.blurb: The profile greeting compiles user input as a Jinja template. {{7*7}} proves it, {{ config }} leaks the secret, a gadget reaches os.popen. Ships with a defender edition.

labs.title: Blind SQL injection in a gift-card lookup
labs.blurb: The page tells you one bit — found or not — and you read a password out of it, one character per request. Ships with a defender edition.
